name: standalone-cluster
help: Configure FortiGate Session Life Support Protocol (FGSP) cluster attributes.

standalone-group-id.name: standalone-group-id
standalone-group-id.help: Cluster group ID (0 - 255). Must be the same for all members.

layer2-connection.name: layer2-connection
layer2-connection.help: Indicate whether layer 2 connections are present among FGSP members.

options.name: available
options.help: There exist layer 2 connections among FGSP members.

options.name: unavailable
options.help: There does not exist layer 2 connection among FGSP members.

session-sync-dev.name: session-sync-dev
session-sync-dev.help: Offload session-sync process to kernel and sync sessions using connected interface(s) directly.

psksecret.name: psksecret
psksecret.help: Pre-shared secret for session synchronization (ASCII string or hexadecimal encoded with a leading 0x).

cluster-peer.name: cluster-peer
cluster-peer.help: Configure FortiGate Session Life Support Protocol (FGSP) session synchronization.

peervd.name: peervd
peervd.help: VDOM that contains the session synchronization link interface on the peer unit. Usually both peers would have the same peervd.

peerip.name: peerip
peerip.help: IP address of the interface on the peer unit that is used for the session synchronization link.

syncvd.name: syncvd
syncvd.help: Sessions from these VDOMs are synchronized using this session synchronization configuration.

down-intfs-before-sess-sync.name: down-intfs-before-sess-sync
down-intfs-before-sess-sync.help: List of interfaces to be turned down before session synchronization is complete.

hb-interval.name: hb-interval
hb-interval.help: Heartbeat interval (1 - 20 (100*ms). Increase to reduce false positives.

hb-lost-threshold.name: hb-lost-threshold
hb-lost-threshold.help: Lost heartbeat threshold (1 - 60). Increase to reduce false positives.

secondary-add-ipsec-routes.name: secondary-add-ipsec-routes
secondary-add-ipsec-routes.help: Enable/disable IKE route announcement on the backup unit.

options.name: enable
options.help: Add IKE routes to the backup unit.

options.name: disable
options.help: Do not add IKE routes to the backup unit.

session-sync-filter.name: session-sync-filter
session-sync-filter.help: Add one or more filters if you only want to synchronize some sessions. Use the filter to configure the types of sessions to synchronize.

srcintf.name: srcintf
srcintf.help: Only sessions from this interface are synchronized.

dstintf.name: dstintf
dstintf.help: Only sessions to this interface are synchronized.

srcaddr.name: srcaddr
srcaddr.help: Only sessions from this IPv4 address are synchronized.

dstaddr.name: dstaddr
dstaddr.help: Only sessions to this IPv4 address are synchronized.

srcaddr6.name: srcaddr6
srcaddr6.help: Only sessions from this IPv6 address are synchronized.

dstaddr6.name: dstaddr6
dstaddr6.help: Only sessions to this IPv6 address are synchronized.

custom-service.name: custom-service
custom-service.help: Only sessions using these custom services are synchronized. Use source and destination port ranges to define these custom services.
